name: project-admin-kit
description: A reusable Firebase admin console and autonomous agent operations platform.

scripts.test: npm run test:admin && npm run test:agents
scripts.test:extras: npm run test:functions && npm run test:testflight
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-project-admin "npm --prefix admin-app run test:rules"
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix admin-app && npm ci --prefix scripts
